usage.costBasis: CLI-reported list-price estimate (total_cost_usd), cumulative per session; not provider-billed
usage.finalMessage:
I added the `quote <customer> <amount>` command and listed it in `help` right after `invoice`. Quotes use the 21-day payment terms now in force (DEC-B12), so a quote made on 2026-03-02 says payable by 2026-03-23. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes, 7 of 7.
One problem is still open: invoices are still issued on the old 30-day terms, so a quote and an invoice made the same day show different dates. Switching invoices to 21 days would change existing behaviour, so I left it as a question for Finance in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
